newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields nudge down, await US PPI.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields nudge down, await US PPI.

text.p: Swedish debt yields followed foreign markets quietly lower on Friday, the yield spread steady over bunds at 90 basis points as the market waited for U.S. PPI data. The crown was little changed.
"The market is very calm. We have followed small movements from other European markets today," one analyst said.
The 10-year yield was down one basis point to 6.47 percent while December T-bill rates were flat on 4.13 percent.
The crown was largely unchanged, with DEM/SEK steady at 4.3960 from 4.3995 on Thursday.
